items.name: ascii-image
items.title: ASCII Image
items.description: An image drawn as a grid of glyphs, each chosen by the ink it actually puts down in the font in use.

credits.author: Codrops

items.name: ascii-morph
items.title: ASCII Morph
items.description: Two subjects that morph into each other and back, each cell resolving in the order its ink changes the most.

items.name: ascii-noise-field
items.title: ASCII Noise Field
items.description: A quiet field of drifting simplex noise, drawn as glyphs chosen by measured density.

items.name: ascii-pointer-ripple
items.title: ASCII Pointer Ripple
items.description: A glyph field of low-density noise that sends rippling rings outward from the pointer, as if the grid were water.

items.name: ascii-rain
items.title: ASCII Rain
items.description: Columns of glyphs fall at their own speed, each with a bright head and a trail that fades down the measured ramp.

credits.author: Simon Whiteley, title design for The Matrix (1999)

items.name: ascii-reveal
items.title: ASCII Reveal
items.description: Text that resolves from scrambled glyphs into its final characters, left to right.

items.name: ascii-solid
items.title: ASCII Solid
items.description: A torus, sphere, or cube rotated in three dimensions and shaded with the measured ramp.

items.name: ascii-text
items.title: ASCII Text
items.description: A headline rastered from a display face, then redrawn as a grid of glyphs chosen by measured ink and shape.

credits.title: Beyond the luminance ramp: a shape-aware ASCII renderer
credits.author: Codrops

items.name: ascii-topo
items.title: ASCII Topo
items.description: Contour lines of a slowly drifting noise height field, drawn like a topographic survey in text.

items.name: ascii-video
items.title: ASCII Video
items.description: A video or webcam feed drawn as a live grid of glyphs, chosen each frame by the ink they put down in the font in use.

items.name: ascii-waves
items.title: ASCII Waves
items.description: Interference between a few drifting circular wave sources, drawn as glyph density that crosses and beats.

items.title: Bar Chart

credits.author: G. Klyne and C. Newman

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: Parts of a whole drawn as a ring, either as SVG segments or a monospace glyph grid, with a hidden data table.

items.description: One number against its range, drawn as an arc with threshold ticks and the value in the middle.

credits.author: Stephen Few

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: A matrix of values displayed as tone-stepped cells with row and column labels and a stepped key.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board

items.title: Scatter Plot

items.title: Timeline Chart

credits.author: Brehmer, Lee, Bach, Henry Riche and Munzner

credits.author: Robert A. Ulichney

credits.title: Spatiotemporal Blue Noise Masks
credits.author: Alan Wolfe, Nathan Morrical, Tomas Akenine-Möller, Ravi Ramamoorthi

items.name: dither-waves

credits.author: Isaac Amidror

items.name: halftone-image

credits.author: John Canny

items.title: Photocopy Image

items.name: pixel-displace-image
items.title: Pixel Displace Image
items.description: A photograph sheared into horizontal bands that slide sideways on a slow noise field, like a printout pulled crooked.

credits.title: Void-and-cluster method for dither array generation
credits.author: Robert A. Ulichney

items.title: Globe

items.name: marquee

items.name: bento-grid

items.name: testimonials

credits.author: Syun-Ichi Akasofu

items.title: Caustic Field

credits.author: M. V. Berry and C. Upstill

items.title: Contour Flow

credits.author: James F. Blinn and Martin E. Newell
